title: My Sister Forged A Codicil, Sold Mama's Bakery For $890K, And Left Me $4,600. So I Voided It
description: After 24 years as my mother's live-in caregiver, my sister forged a codicil, sold our historic bakery for $890,000, and mailed me a $4,600 'flour' check. I found Mama's original will inside her hollow wooden rolling pin, voided the sale, and reopened as Dough of Deceit Bakery. Now my sister scrubs proofing baskets in an 'Iced My Inheritance' smock while every pastry box prints her probate fraud docket. #probatefraud #familybetrayal #karma
thumb_text: SHE LEFT ME $4,600. I LEFT HER SCRUBBING.
pinned_comment: If your sister forged a probate codicil after 24 years of caregiving and mailed you a $4,600 flour check, would you void the sale or let her keep the bakery? Tell me in the comments if a relative ever tried to erase your inheritance.
